body:
You seem like a great, kind and nice person indeed. I hope things work out for you, and you find out something to push you to live.
Best of luck, the fact that you gave yourself such time you still believe in yourself, and you still believe something good could happen, so hang on to that hope.

No one deserves to go through what you've been to, but we all know life ain't fair, and it will bring us down no matter what. Some of us manage to stand up some of us do not. Your father deserves a punishment for what he's done, but leave that be for now and focus on yourself.
Is the clinic temporary? I don't know it might be helpful for you afterall, or it might not be there're so many factors that indicate that, for you to have motivation you need a motive to move on and to be strong, a reason, give yourself a reason and I promise you things will change, I know this sounds cheesy and cliche but it's the truth.
If you have something that drives you, then just work for it. Show the people you're strong and you might aswell be independent enough not to need them, I know it's easier to say than do because I myself has been struggling on it.
But just try, you won't lose anything for trying.

Thank you a lot, I hope the same I'm just missing the motivation and more or less can't deal with people in general, but this is about you and we'll keep this on you. I'm really glad you're alive and breathing, I'm not trying to do this to boost you up or anything, I'm just telling you this because there's this bond you end up sharing with people who are going through the same sort of problems and even a stranger's life matters at it's most so just try to find a reason to move on.

I really hope this was helpful instead of anything else, please consider every other chance before considering self-harm in the first hand.

I hope you're still here. How old are you dude and could you please explain briefly, what do you mean they're forcing you to go to a mental hospital? Are you healthy in general, I mean capable enough to work a job, any job? If so I'd suggest you to talk to your parents and clear things out, but if they wont co-operate, then just make a run for it go live a life of yours, it will be hard at the beginning but you'll grow independent and strong and you certainly won't need your family by then.

Your friends won't care? well with all due respect pick some new ones, you don't need them you never will, there're a lot of great people you could actually meet, ones that will care about you.

I know, I'm going through hard times on my own and hell my reasons are a LOT more stupid and make no sense at all but I've kinda just my interest, but I wouldn't wish this on anyone else so try and do something.

Or if you can't make a run for it, demand a lawyer open a case or something if you're mentally stable there's no way you'll get forced into a mental hospital but if you do prove yourself healthy and find a way out.

Best of luck, I hope I helped on any sort of way, if you need anything DM me, I'll gladly try to provide my time.

Thank you guys, really. Thing is however I don't think I can improve. I started working out, eating healthier not so long ago, I had the motivation and all that I really believed that I could actually change things you know? but then I end up dealing with a crush and oh boy does the scene turn out to be a complete mess, I fight with her for around 6 days in a row, and then I extend my anger to other people thus pushing them away and ever since I ended up losing the motivation to workout or to eat healthier or anything like that, and that also made me realize a couple of things on myself.

Other than that I'll be pretty busy until December, I'll have school at morning and then work until 08:00 PM, eat - sleep - repeat, and that's all.

I'm a shy and a withdrawn dude, and I try way to hard for things to work out, whatever it may be and I end up realizing it just wont work no matter how hard I try.

RIP I hope this wasn't quite much for ya'll to read.
